about: BN5's NapalmSoul and its charged shot in both engines (docs/game/team-protoman.md, unit 8): its flag entry written in BN5's ROM copy and set (souls5), the Souls installed in BN6's engine holding it (souls6 bit 21), a deck of FireHit1 (BN5's 151 O, BN6's 107 D: Fire, NapalmSoul's kind), the first Custom screen's chip picked and given up, UNITE and OK; it unites as the first turn starts: his look, his loadout in BN6's numbers, his element Fire. Every frame compared, MegaMan's own state a difference.
